fixer.summary: nimble_escape now refuses a creature without the trait with page=290, rule=MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior#24 (tagged SRD[...#24]). It also refuses any option other than Disengage or Hide, where before anything else silently became a Hide. Unit tests added. Unit suite, ticket test (--runxfail), ruff and dev-gate all pass.

review.summary: The fix solves the ticket. When a creature without the Nimble Escape trait tries to use it, the refusal now cites page=290 and rule="MONSTER.goblins.goblin-warrior#24". The unit's pages field confirms page 290, and #24 is stage A's Nimble Escape clause. The engine already had a trait check (the `traits` list in the monster data), and the fix adds the citation to that check rather than building a second one. The strict xfail on test_a_bandit_has_no_nimble_escape was removed, and that acceptance test now passes. The change also rejects any action other than Disengage or Hide. That goes a little beyond the ticket, but it enforces the same clause and fixes a real wrong result: before, any value other than "disengage" (say, "dash") silently became Hide. That check is a test of the parameter, not a special case for a fixture. The unit tests check what the engine does: a refused bandit gains no Disengage effect, Dash is refused for a goblin, and "Disengage" with a capital letter still works. The SRD comment sits on the code that implements the rule. Making Disengage a Bonus Action without the trait is already covered by open ticket T-75, so I filed no follow-up.
